type.description: master keys have no linked supplier; supplier keys link to exactly one supplier

supplier_name.description: Supplier display name (denormalized for fast lookup)

supplier_id.description: Reference to Supplier record (optional for master keys)

vertical.description: Optional vertical code this key is used for

key.description: LEGACY cleartext key. Retained only until the hash path is proven against real supplier traffic, then purged. Task S4. Never write this on a new key and never return it to a client.

key_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the raw key. This is the credential of record. Resolved by server/src/lib/apiKeys.js, which is the only module that may derive or compare it.

key_prefix.description: First 16 chars of key, shown in UI so an operator can tell keys apart

allowed_ips.description: JSON array of allowed IP addresses, optional

expose_revenue.description: When true, supplier responses may include revenue
